practicals.title: Practical-1
content: Create database tables using CREATE statement (define fields, data
types, and constraints).

practicals.title: Practical-2
content: Insert records into the tables created in Practical 1 using INSERT
statement.

practicals.title: Practical-3
content: Retrieve all records and specific columns using basic SELECT
statement.

practicals.title: Practical-4
content: Delete specific records from the tables using DELETE statement
with condition.

practicals.title: Practical-5
content: Modify existing records in the tables using UPDATE statement with
condition.

practicals.title: Practical-6
content: Retrieve filtered rows using WHERE clause and select specific
columns.

practicals.title: Practical-7
content: Display records using ORDER BY clause and remove duplicate
values using DISTINCT.(Sorting and Distinct Values)

practicals.title: Practical-8
content: Apply aggregate functions such as COUNT, SUM, AVG, MIN, and
MAX on table data.

practicals.title: Practical-9
content: Group records using GROUP BY clause and filter grouped data
using HAVING clause.

practicals.title: Practical-10
content: Retrieve data from multiple tables using different types of JOIN
operations.

practicals.title: Practical-11
content: Retrieve data using nested SELECT statements (subqueries).

practicals.title: Practical-12
content: Modify table structure using ALTER statement and apply
constraints like PRIMARY KEY, FOREIGN KEY, UNIQUE, and
NOT NULL.
Total Hours 56
